headline: CHINA 🚨 Warns of 'HIGH RISK' 🌊 Lake BREACH 💥 Causing SECOND FLOOD 🌧️
text:
CHINA 🇨🇳 just DROPPED 💧 a BOMBSHELL ⚠️ warning that this BARRIER lake 🏞️ formed after the LANDSLIDE 🪨 near the NEPAL 🇳🇵 TIBET 🏔️ border has a HIGH RISK 🌡️ of BREACHING its banks 🏦 and UNLEASHING 💦 a SECOND FLOOD 🌊 downstream!! The alert 🚨 comes right after WEDNESDAY'S ☀️ deadly FLASH FLOOD 💥 in the SAME SPOT 📍 which scientists 🧪 say was triggered by a MOUNTAIN GLACIER 🧊 collapsing 🫳 into the river 🏞️ like a massive ICE COCKTAIL 🍹 gone wrong!! As of FRIDAY 🗓️ an estimated TWO POINT FIVE MILLION 2️⃣5️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️⃣ cubic METRES 📏 of WATER 💧 had already ACCUMULATED 🛢️ according to broadcaster CCTV 📺 with officials 👮 saying THREE MILLION 3️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️⃣ cubic METRES more expected to POUR 🪣 in between THURSDAY ⏰ and the WEEKEND 🌅 posing that HIGH RISK 🌋 of a BREACH 💥!! Experts 🧠 have told the BBC 📻 though that it was POSSIBLE 🫴 the lake could just DRAIN 🕳️ out NATURALLY 🌿 over time without turning into a total DISASTER 🍿 and honestly bro the whole valley already looks down bad 😩 after getting RAILED by that first surge.

China's MINISTRY 🏛️ of WATER RESOURCES 💧 described the BARRIER LAKE 🛡️ as a body of WATER 💦 formed when DEBRIS 🪨 DAMS up a river at the CONFLUENCE 🤝 of the CHHOCHEN KHOLA 🏞️ and PUREPU TSANGPO rivers 🌊 it sits right near the LANGTANG LIRUNG PEAK 🏔️ where that COLLAPSED GLACIER 🧊 originated several KILOMETRES 📏 upstream from GYIRONG PORT 🚪 the major land CROSSING 🛣️ linking NEPAL 🇳🇵 and CHINA 🇨🇳 that got absolutely POUNDED 💥 by Wednesday's massive FLOOD 🌊!! The barrier lake started to OVERFLOW 🪣 on THURSDAY ⏰ then on FRIDAY MORNING 🌅 a Chinese MILITARY DRONE 🛰️ captured FOOTAGE 🎥 of an AVALANCHE ❄️ on a snow-capped MOUNTAIN ⛰️ which dumped an estimated FIFTY THOUSAND 5️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️⃣ cubic METRES of ICE DEBRIS 🧊 straight into the barrier lake like it was trying to TOP IT OFF 🍸!! Authorities 📢 issued WARNINGS ⚠️ and ORDERS 📜 to prepare for EMERGENCY EVACUATIONS 🏃‍♂️ while rescue work 🛟 was SUSPENDED 🚫 as most Chinese emergency services stopped at a village about SEVEN KILOMETRES 7️⃣ km away from GYIRONG PORT 🛑 because that lake was OVERFLOWING NON-STOP 🏞️ which could lead to fresh FLOODS 🌊 or DEBRIS FLOWS 🪨 according to a CCTV report 📺 and let me tell you the valley walls already scoured and vulnerable were basically BEGGING for more TROUBLE 😩.

By FRIDAY AFTERNOON 🌇 state media 📺 reported that the RISK from the UPSTREAM BARRIER LAKE 🏞️ had come UNDER CONTROL 🛠️ and that RESCUE OPERATIONS 🛟 had RESUMED ✅ with authorities sending ENGINEERING TEAMS 👷 to MONITOR 📊 the lake's WATER LEVELS 💧 and the ATMOSPHERIC CONDITIONS 🌧️ while DRONES 🛰️ have been FLOWN in to DROP OFF equipment and SUPPLIES 📦 like a high altitude CARE PACKAGE 🎁!! JAKOB STEINER 🧔 a geoscientist with the UNIVERSITY OF GRAZ 🏫 who has researched LAKE BURSTS 💥 in NEPAL 🇳🇵 told the BBC 📻 there was STILL a POSSIBILITY that the lake could BREACH its banks 🏦 because not all the MATERIAL 🪨 on the mountain could have COME DOWN ⬇️ it is still UNSTABLE 🫨 so there's a CHANCE something will DROP 🪨 and if that material hits the lake or even further UPSTREAM 🌊 then we have a PROBLEM 🍆!! Chinese state media have also reported there will be HEAVY RAINFALL 🌧️ and STORMS ⛈️ in the region in the coming DAYS 📅 raising CONCERNS that this may cause the lake to SWELL 🫄 like it's about to BURST at the seams and honestly the whole situation got everyone edging on evacuation orders 🚨.

If the lake BREACHES its banks 🏦 there will NOT likely be a MASSIVE DELUGE 🌊 of water as seen on WEDNESDAY ☀️ as the lake formed RECENTLY 🆕 and was not very DEEP 🕳️ said STEINER 🧔 however the water discharged could further UNDERCUT the valley's SLOPES 🏔️ and cause more EROSION 🌋 which could in turn cause MORE LANDSLIDES 🪨!! Authorities need to be VERY CAREFUL ⚠️ for the RESCUE 🛟 and prepared for any SECONDARY WAVE 🌊 and POST-DISASTER LANDSLIDES 🪨 as the valley walls have been SCOURED 🧼 and much more VULNERABLE 😣 said MOHD FAROOQ AZAM 🧪 a glacio-hydrologist with the INTERNATIONAL CENTRE for INTEGRATED MOUNTAIN DEVELOPMENT 🏔️ and you just know that after getting COOKED by the first flood the locals are staying far away from those riverbanks 🏞️ until further notice bro.

STEINER 🧔 said it was UNLIKELY that the Chinese could STOP the lake from OVERFLOWING 🪣 he pointed out that while it was TECHNICALLY POSSIBLE to artificially DRAIN the lake using EXCAVATORS 🚜 there were no proper ROADS 🛣️ that would allow them to transport heavy MACHINERY 🛠️ to the lake's LOCATION 🗺️ so they basically can't even get the equipment up there to EDGE it down safely!! Both experts said it was POSSIBLE that the PROBLEM could eventually RESOLVE itself with AZAM pointing to recent FLASH FLOODS 🌊 in INDIA's CHAMOLI and DHARALI where artificial lakes DRAINED SLOWLY 🐢 without much IMPACT downstream and similarly the only thing CHINA 🇨🇳 can do is HOPE 🙏 that the water will slowly DRAIN OUT NATURALLY 🌿 out of the barrier lake in TIBET 🏔️!! And it will slowly drain the MELTING SEASON 🧊 will be over by OCTOBER 🍂 so things are going to get CALMER 🌬️ there's going to be LESS WATER 💧 and then by WINTER ❄️ what's left will be all FROZEN 🧊 like nature's own plug finally getting pulled after a long night of getting railed by glaciers and avalanches.

Separately NEPALI 🇳🇵 authorities have WARNED ⚠️ of the risk of BLOCKAGES 🪨 causing further FLOODS 🌊 along the BHOTE KOSHI 🏞️ and TRISHULI rivers 🌊 they have warned people to STAY AWAY 🚫 from the rivers until further NOTICE 📢!! Scientists 🧪 have said that the flood on WEDNESDAY ☀️ was likely to have been caused by part of a GLACIER 🧊 near LANGTANG LIRUNG collapsing into the river below which in turn caused a MASSIVE SURGE 🌊 downstream carrying WATER 💧 and DEBRIS 🪨 several HUNDRED people have DIED ☠️ in NEPAL 🇳🇵 with hundreds more still MISSING 🕳️ after the flash flood on the TIBET side of the border alone more than FIVE HUNDRED FIFTY 5️⃣5️⃣0️⃣ are missing nearly HALF of whom are FOREIGNERS 🌍 and the whole region is still recovering from getting absolutely POUNDED by that initial icy load 💦.
